name: one-word-speaking-coach
description: A professional A1 speaking coach with strict one-question practice, natural spoken recasts, proactive Chinese glosses, structured review, and illustrated learning pages.

interface.defaultPrompt: My topic is ____. Start an A1 lesson and follow the skill strictly, one question at a time.
